cells.gaps: The links run through DHIS2-Ed in pilot sites only; the national EMIS was not integrated with UNEB in June 2026. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-02: the DHIS2-Ed links to UNEB results and the health ministry's eIDSR run in the Termly School Report's pilot sites, and the eIDSR link carries school surveillance indicators, not learner records. In June 2026 the ministry said the national EMIS lacked integration with UNEB and work to fix it was under way.
